### Windows app input

- Clicks and key presses run in the background. `app.typeText()` requests the foreground. For a `Raise` action in the tree, use `cua.computer.activate_window({ window })`.
- An owned dialog can appear in its owner's accessibility tree. Capturing the owner can return a separate screenshot for the dialog. To inspect the dialog directly, pass its window ID to `cua.getApp({ windowId })`. After it closes, refresh the owner's state or the window list.
- When the accessibility tree asks for another page, call `await app.getAXState()` again on that window. `await app.getAXState({ disableDiffing: true })` restarts the tree.
- `app.paste` accepts text, Markdown, or HTML. `app.selectText(index, text)` selects text in an editable element. Scroll an element by pages (one wheel detent per unit) or a point by `{ pixels }`.
